This is an uncertain inference from delayed, lower-bound reports.

hypotheses.claim: The opponent appears to be holding a stable cluster of about six bots at node 2 (24,8) for the entire observed window; every sampled sighting and node_status places opponents there with a constant count of 6, and nodes 0 and 1 show zero opponent sightings. This is an uncertain inference from delayed, lower-bound reports.
hypotheses.alternative: The opponent may have split or moved bots to nodes 0 or 1 outside sensor range or in unreported cells; zero sightings there are lower bounds, not proof of emptiness, and node 2 sightings could be stale since reports lag 20 ticks.
